profile.headline: Always learning. Always growing.
profile.summary: I️ am a goal oriented developer with strong knowledge in clinical analytics development in CQL using the R4 FHIR standard. I also have skills in backend development using python/django. I️ am extremely motivated to continue learning and expanding my machine learning and data science skillset as well as application development using C#/DOTNET.

positions.title: Digital Measure Programmer I
positions.description:
Code digital quality measures in Clinical Quality Language (CQL) using the FHIR data standard. 
Process improvement and automation using python.

positions.title: Clinical Microbiologist
positions.description:
As part of the microbiology team I️ worked directly on processing a high volume of cultures in order to ID and perform susceptibility testing on the pathogenic bacterial isolates.

Read and interpret bacterial cultures. ID and AST testing performed using Bruker MALDI-TOF and Phoenix platforms. Perform molecular testing using Cephid GenExpert, Biomerieux Biofire, and Luminex Aries.

positions.title: Testing Technician
positions.description: As a Testing Technologist I worked in a small team to test a high volume of plasma samples and perform any necessary maintenance needed on the testing analyzers.

positions.title: Infusionsoft Success Consultant
positions.description:
At this position I utilized my deep understanding of the Infusionsoft application to help new users implement their marketing strategies and fully
utilize the power of automation.
- I provided great value to my company by ensuring customer needs within the software were always met, whether that meant creating custom
dashboards and reports or the creation and implementation of complex marketing automation campaigns.
